title: 第14章 猎户第15章 妖兽
slug: 我在玄幻世界召唤奇物
content_zh:
“黄粱一梦。”
一身淡蓝色衣服的石修站在名为黄粱一梦的店铺门口，看着店里面安静趴在桌上熟睡的八人。
通过衣服就可以看出来，有的是商人，有的是猎户，应该是客人了
至于睡觉，想必就是齐源口中的梦中填补遗憾。
说实话石修挺意外的，来之前还以为黄粱一梦这种神奇的东西，价格一定不便宜，毕竟药师做出来的东西，都贵得很。
但是现在看来价格应该不贵，毕竟猎户都能用得起。
轻手轻脚的走进店铺，就看到在柜台旁边闭目养神的齐源。
好像是感受到了视线，于是齐源睁开眼睛看向来人。
等看到来人是石修，齐源安静起身领着石修走到后院石桌旁坐下。
拿起桌上的糕点递给石修：“尝尝，这个豆沙糕，味道还不错。”
接过齐源给的豆沙糕，没有第一时间吃，而是问出了心中的疑惑：“齐兄弟，你这黄粱一梦作价几何，我看店里有不少猎户，想必价格应该不贵吧。”
齐源微微一笑：“价格不贵，一次十两银子，店里那些都是新来的，只是给他们试下，第一次不收钱的。”
石修拿着糕点的手一僵，这黄粱一梦真的有那么神奇的话，价格再怎么样也不至于一次十两啊。
难道黄粱一梦没有齐源说的那么神奇，齐源的师傅也不是药师？
“那我师傅的伤势岂不是...”
“石兄...石兄...想什么呢，看你脸色不太好。”看着眼前一会面色僵硬，一会面露失望的石修，齐源打断了他的内心活动。
“没有，没有，就是在想一些事情。”回过神来的石修连忙说道，边说还边往嘴里塞着糕点。
齐源没有继续问下去，而是说道：“石兄弟要不要试试黄粱一梦。”
石修点了点头，虽然齐源的师傅不是药师，但是试试也无妨。
他也很想知道黄粱一梦的实际效果是什么样的。

于是齐源起身去那群熟睡的人中间拿了个香炉回来。
这几天齐源并不是什么都没做，一到晚上就让黄粱一梦吞噬周边居民的精神。
控制好吞噬的量，而且梦境也只是模糊不清。
等他们睡醒也只会觉得没有睡好，也不记得梦境里面发生了什么。
现在心雾已经有一次性入梦几十个人的量了。
香炉放在石桌上，齐源手轻轻一抚一道烟雾就从香炉中飘出，渐渐飘向石修：“放松心神。”
等石修吸进烟雾之后就开始昏昏沉沉，一股困意涌上心头，没坚持几秒就趴在石桌上睡着了。
也是在这时，之前进入梦境的那些人也渐渐苏醒，听到动静，齐源看了一眼石修，就朝着那群苏醒的人走去。
率先苏醒的是一个猎户，此人叫王二牛，按他的说法，因为他生下来的时候，家里母牛刚好生了第二胎，所以父母就给他取名二牛。
这人是李大海介绍来的猎户，与之一同过来的还有同村的四人。
他们村子都离云梦城比较近，所以平时山中打猎获得的动物都会到云梦城贩卖。
偶尔在山中获得的一些珍稀草药也会拿到城里药铺贩卖，一来二去就跟李大海熟悉了。
有的时候李大海也会在他手里购买一些野味解解馋。
这次来云梦城就是为了处理手中的猎物，然后李大海就跟王二牛说了齐源的事情，
content_en:
"Huang Liang is a dream."
Shi Xiu, dressed in light blue clothes, stood at the door of a shop named Huangliang Yimeng, looking at the eight people sleeping quietly on the table inside the shop.
You can tell by their clothes that some are businessmen and some are hunters, so they must be guests.
As for sleeping, it must be what Qi Yuan said about filling regrets in dreams.
To be honest, Shi Xiu was quite surprised. Before coming here, he thought that a magical thing like Huangliang Yimeng must be expensive. After all, the things made by pharmacists are very expensive.
But now it seems that the price should not be expensive, after all, Orions can afford it.
Walking into the store quietly, he saw Qi Yuan closing his eyes and concentrating next to the counter.
As if feeling the sight, Qi Yuan opened his eyes and looked at the person.
When he saw that the person coming was Shi Xiu, Qi Yuan stood up quietly and led Shi Xiu to the stone table in the backyard to sit down.
He picked up the pastry on the table and handed it to Shi Xiu: "Try it, this bean paste cake, it tastes pretty good."
After taking the bean paste cake from Qi Yuan, he did not eat it immediately, but asked his doubts: "Brother Qi, how much does your yellow rice cake cost? I see that there are many hunters in the store, so the price must not be expensive."
Qi Yuan smiled slightly: "The price is not expensive, only ten taels of silver a time. The ones in the store are all new ones. I just give them a try. There is no charge for the first time."
Shi Xiu's hand holding the pastry froze. If Huangliang Yimeng was really that magical, the price wouldn't be more than ten taels a time no matter what.
Is Huangliang Yimeng not as magical as Qi Yuan said, and Qi Yuan's master is not a pharmacist?
"Then my master's injury isn't..."
"Brother Shi...Brother Shi...what are you thinking about? You don't look good." Looking at Shi Xiu, who looked stiff at first and disappointed at other times, Qi Yuan interrupted his inner activities.
"No, no, I'm just thinking about something." Shi Xiu said quickly after coming back to his senses, stuffing cakes into his mouth as he spoke.
Qi Yuan did not continue to ask, but said: "Brother Shi, do you want to try Huangliang Yimeng?"
Shi Xiu nodded. Although Qi Yuan's master was not a pharmacist, there was no harm in giving it a try.
He also wanted to know what the actual effect of Huang Liang Yimeng was.
So Qi Yuan got up and went to get an incense burner from among the sleeping people.
It's not that Qi Yuan has done nothing these days. At night, Huang Liang Yimeng swallows up the spirits of the surrounding residents.
Control the amount you swallow, and the dreams are only vague.
When they wake up, they will only feel that they did not sleep well, and they will not remember what happened in the dream.
Now the mental fog is enough to cause dozens of people to fall asleep at once.
The incense burner was placed on the stone table. Qi Yuan gently touched his hand and a stream of smoke floated out from the incense burner, gradually drifting towards Shi Xiu: "Relax your mind."
After Shi Xiu breathed in the smoke, he began to feel drowsy. A wave of sleepiness surged into his heart, and he fell asleep on the stone table within a few seconds.
It was also at this time that the people who had entered the dreamland gradually woke up. Upon hearing the movement, Qi Yuan glanced at Shi Xiu and walked towards the group of people who had woken up.
The first one to wake up was a hunter named Wang Erniu. According to him, because when he was born, the family cow just gave birth to its second calf, so his parents named him Erniu.
This man was the Orion introduced by Li Dahai, and he was accompanied by four people from the same village.
Their villages are relatively close to Yunmeng City, so animals usually obtained from hunting in the mountains are sold in Yunmeng City.
Occasionally, some rare herbs obtained in the mountains would be sold in drug stores in the city, and Li Dahai became familiar with them over and over again.
Sometimes Li Dahai would buy some game from him to satisfy his craving.
This time he came to Yunmeng City to deal with the prey in his hands, and then Li Dahai told Wang Erniu about Qi Yuan.
